arguments.code:
# Filter recommended songs to those released in this or last year and with genre R&B
from datetime import datetime
now = datetime.now(); this_year = now.year; last_year = this_year - 1
relevant_years = {this_year, last_year}
print('relevant_years', relevant_years)

# 'recs' list from earlier execution is not guaranteed to persist? We'll re-fetch recommendations quickly.
# Re-fetch full pages
recs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('recommendations page', page_index, 'len', (len(resp) if isinstance(resp, list) else 'NA'))
    if not isinstance(resp, list) or len(resp)==0:
        break
    recs.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

song_ids = [r['song_id'] for r in recs]
print('total recommended song_ids', len(song_ids))

# Fetch details and filter
filtered = []
for sid in song_ids:
    sd = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    # parse release_date year
    rd = sd.get('release_date')
    year = None
    if rd:
        year = int(rd[:4])
    genre = sd.get('genre')
    if year in relevant_years and genre == 'R&B':
        filtered.append({'song_id': sid, 'title': sd['title'], 'release_year': year, 'album_title': sd['album_title']})

print('filtered_count', len(filtered))
print('filtered', filtered)
